results.title: FG to enforce standards, value for money on road projects — Tinubu
results.description: President Bola Tinubu says his administration will enforce quality standards, transparency and value for money in all ongoing road projects across the country. Tinubu made the pledge during the flag-off of the Osogbo–Iwo–Ibadan and Gbongan–Osogbo road projects on Thursday in Osogbo.
